about.title: About KikobaConnect
about.heroSubtitle: We are on a mission to modernize community savings groups across Africa by providing transparent, secure, and easy-to-use digital tools.
about.storyP1: Traditional savings groups (Kikoba, VICOBA, SACCO) are the backbone of many communities. However, managing funds manually with notebooks and calculators often leads to disputes, missing records, and lost opportunities.
about.storyP2: We built KikobaConnect to solve this. We provide a single platform where groups can track contributions, manage loans, vote on decisions, and communicate securely.
about.missionDesc: To empower every community with the financial technology they need to grow together securely and fairly.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to KikobaConnect. These terms explain the rules for using our platform. By using our service, you agree to these rules. We have written them in simple language so everyone can understand.

s1.title: Using Our Service
s1.text: KikobaConnect is a digital platform that helps savings groups manage money, loans, and communication. You must be at least 18 years old to use this service. You agree to provide accurate information about yourself and your group.

s2.title: Your Responsibilities
s2.text: You are responsible for keeping your password safe. Do not share your account with anyone. You must not use the platform for any illegal activity. All contributions and loans must be recorded honestly.

s3.title: Electronic Agreements
s3.text: Under the Electronic Transactions Act, 2015, your electronic actions on this platform are legally binding. When you click 'confirm' on a contribution or loan, it is the same as signing a paper document.

s4.title: Data and Privacy
s4.text: We collect and protect your personal information according to the Personal Data Protection Act, 2022. Our Privacy Policy explains exactly how we handle your data. By using KikobaConnect, you agree to our Privacy Policy.

s5.title: Prohibited Actions
s5.text: You must not attempt to hack the platform, send false information, or use the service to harass other members. Under the Cybercrimes Act, 2015, these actions are serious offences and will be reported to the Police.

s6.title: Changes to These Terms
s6.text: We may update these terms from time to time. When we do, we will notify you through the app. If you continue using the service after changes are made, it means you accept the new terms.

terms.contactText: If you have questions about these Terms, please contact us.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, and how we protect it. We follow the Personal Data Protection Act, 2022 of Tanzania.

s1.title: What Information We Collect
s1.text: We collect information you give us when you register, such as your name, phone number, and group details. We also record your contributions, loans, and messages to keep the platform working correctly.

s2.title: How We Use Your Information
s2.text: We use your information only for the following purposes:
s2.item1: To operate your account and process your contributions and loans.
s2.item2: To send you important notifications about your group.
s2.item3: To keep the platform safe and prevent fraud.

s3.title: Your Rights
s3.text: Under the law, you have the right to ask us what data we hold about you. You can also ask us to correct any wrong information. If you want to see, change, or delete your data, contact us.

s4.title: How We Protect Your Data
s4.text: We use strong security measures to protect your information. This includes encryption for private chats and secure servers. We do not share your personal data with anyone outside your group without your permission, unless the law requires us to.

s5.title: Your Communications
s5.text: Under Article 16 of the Constitution of Tanzania, your private communications are protected. We do not read your private messages. We only store them securely so you and your group members can access them.

s6.title: Reporting Problems
s6.text: If you believe your data has been misused, please contact us immediately. You also have the right to report a concern to the Personal Data Protection Commission of Tanzania.

privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about your privacy, please reach out to us.
